Acquisition Act., For Determination Of Enhancement
Of Compensation.

This Appeal Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

The claimant in LAC No.268 of 2006 has filed this appeal challenging the judgment and award dated 12th January, 2007 passed in LAC No.268 of 2006 by the Additional Civil Judge (Sr. Dn.),
Hassan and the judgment and award dated 2nd February, 2015 passed in R.A. No.464 of 2014 by the Principal District Judge at Hassan, whereby compensation in respect of the subject land is fixed at Rs.2,14,500/- per acre.
2.

The land bearing Survey No.313/3 measuring 14 guntas situate at Handinakere village, Kasaba Hobli, Hassan Taluk and District was acquired for the purpose of Yagachi Reservoir Project under the preliminary notification dated 25th September, 1997 which culminated in passing of the award by the Land Acquisition Officer fixing marked value of the said land at the rate of Rs.80,000/- per acre by treating it as a dry land.

Reference Court, fixed the marked value at the rate of Rs.1,43,000/-
per acre against which appellant/claimant filed an appeal before the District Judge.
Learned District Judge, by impugned judgment, fixed the market value at Rs.2,14,500/- per acre, against which the present appeal is filed by the claimant.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent.

4. The learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Reference Court in LAC No.44 of 2016, by judgment and award dated 02nd November, 2016, has fixed market value of the acquired land therein, which was acquired under the very same notification dated 25th September, 1997 and for the very same purpose, at Rs.1.00 lakh per gunta.

entities.text: Sri. Krishnegowda vs The State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Hon'ble Apex Court, in the case of UNION OF INDIA (UOI) V. BAL RAM AND ANOTHER reported in AIR 2004 SC 3981 has held that it would be unfair to discriminate between the land owners to pay more to some and less to others when the purpose of acquisition is same and lands are identical and similar though lying in differing villages.

entities.text: UNION OF INDIA (UOI) V. BAL RAM AND ANOTHER reported in AIR 2004 SC 3981
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Hence, the market value of the subject land which is acquired for the very same purpose is required to be fixed at the rate of Rs.1,00,000/-
per gunta, to maintain parity.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed;
(ii) Market value of the subject land is fixed at Rs.1,00,000/- per gunta with all admissible statutory benefit including cost;
(iii) It is made clear that appellant/claimant is not entitled for the interest for the delayed period of 1782 days in filing the appeal.
In view of disposal of the main matter, IA.II of 2020 does not survive consideration.
Sd/-
